messages:
Alex: starting deploy window — coordinated canary for API/runtime/console/router, kicking off now. routing pins: api@1.8.0, runtime@2.3.1, router@0.9.5, console@3.0.0-rc2

deploy-bot: deploy queued: wave-1 -> staging-router + runtime-pool-a + api-canary (5% traffic). estimate 30m for wave1

Marta: note: console RC2 has minor telemetry gap in metrics ingestion. will watch console_ui_errors metric.

Sanjeev: rollback guardrails we agreed: 1) >=5% increase in API error_rate sustained over 2m OR 2) p95 latency > 800ms sustained for 10m => trigger rollback. also KV cache eviction spike >3x is a hard stop.

Kevin: adding routing hedge: if api error_rate > 3% then shift traffic to dedicated fallback model-variant (model: redwood-small-fallback) and pause console rollout.

Alex: changing autoscale for runtime pool-a to avoid noisy warmups — setting min=max=4 for next 20m.

Marta: can we also pin the console route to read-only backend during canary? reduces churn.

Alex: yes, setting console route flag: `console.read_only=true` for canary.

Sanjeev: ops quick reference (putting runbook snippet here):
```
# emergency rollback (preferred staged rollback)
# 1) router -> revert to previous image
# 2) api -> rollback to api@1.7.x
# 3) runtime -> rollback runtime pool to snapshot-2026-03-20
# 4) console -> disable rc route
./rollout rollback --service router --tag previous
./rollout rollback --service api --tag 1.7.9
```

Kevin: telemetry set: api_errors, api_p95, runtime_kv_evictions, router_conn_errors, console_ui_errors. alert thresholds set in paging: api_p95>750ms, api_errors>3%

deploy-bot: wave-1 completed: health checks pass. traffic 5% -> canary. scheduling wave-2 in 25m (30% traffic).

Marta: confirm release notes link: https://internal.redwood/release/2026-03-21-deploy — added model-variant pins and console read-only note.

Alex: rollout cadence: wave2 30% -> 30m, wave3 100% after successful metrics window. if any hard-stop errors, we abort and follow staged rollback above.

ops-runbook-bot: reminder: change window ends 2026-03-21T22:00Z; autoscale unfreeze will be automatic at end of window.

Sanjeev: approval path: lead-eng + oncall for rollback. emergency allowed by SRE if production impact > customer-facing SLA. please @mention `@sanjeev` + `#eng-oncall` to start.

Kevin: small ask — add runtime metric to dashboard: `runtime.kv_cache_miss_rate` (alert if > 2% sustained 10m).

Alex: added dash widget. starting wave-2 now. ping if you see anomalies. :rocket: 

Marta: monitoring looks clean so far. no spike in evictions.

deploy-bot: wave-2 success -> traffic 30%. scheduling final wave in 35m.

Sanjeev: if we opt to rollback after wave-3, follow staged sequence (router->api->runtime->console) to avoid routing blackholes. document that in the runbook.

Alex: noted. final wave will be manual approval from lead-eng. thanks all. :thumbsup:
